remaining_requirements: Add non-Python or cross-language sources before applying the 80% maximum language-share gate to the full corpus.
Run collection-export and collection-audit for public issue and PR records from fixed commits.
Add a CI-specific record contract before using CI collection tasks as trainable source records.
Generate repository-grounded synthetic backfill only for under-covered families and verifier types.
Materialize train and holdout registries, then run seed and scenario decontamination audits.
Approve a stratified human-review sample and a small DeepSeek V4 Pro pilot before larger shards.

rollout_plan.exit_gate: The checked-in corpus policy and repository allowlist pass static tests and allowlist audits.
All exported public records pass collection audit, allowlist filtering, fixed-revision checks, and quarantine budgets.
Train and holdout registries pass validation, seed coverage gates, reset health checks, and scenario decontamination.
A stratified review queue is approved or every actionable issue is quarantined.
A small registry-backed DeepSeek V4 Pro pilot passes trace-quality, cost, reward, and verifier-success thresholds.
A frozen manifest records source snapshots, audit outputs, review decisions, pilot results, and explicit scale approval.

scale_decision.reason: Production scale-up requires real source export audits, seed-corpus manifest validity, human review approval, and a passing pilot quality report.
